title: Audit rounded raw Gaussian forward and stored-inverse callers
body:
The raw Gaussian caller must pass its rounded intermediate vector to the normalized child at the correct radius and shared grid, then account for stored reciprocal coefficients and the same immutable reference. This package independently proves that forward and stored-inverse composition at `RAW-GAUSSIAN-PROOF.md` §7. Under the explicit normalized child contract, the raw error is below `3τ/8`; the same-reference forward and inverse errors are below `τ/2` and `5τ/8`. It audits the existing allocation without changing its precision.

The independent exact engine runs four actual `RawGaussian` size-two factories: narrow/broad, both center-phase signs, both directions. Across 24 trajectories and 1008 coordinate roundings it agrees with actual source execution and checks the child entrance, shared grid, stored inverse and reference charges. Five controls distinguish inverse order, wrong child grid/radius, reciprocal sensitivity and amplified input rounding. This follows #4756's admission-only boundary; the normalized theorem, global core/halo composition and native costs remain separate obligations. No selected-frontier or complete multiplication claim.

Validation: metadata/source pins; registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replay; committed-byte/source-history preflight (23 package/input files); official export integrity; Git-free normal/optimized replay with all 24 exported files unchanged. No Lean, Docker or full historical replay. Proof and limits: `research/raw-gaussian-rounded-caller/README.md`.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19131469

Submission uses canonical base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority 7. The 19:49 UTC complete refresh covered 299 open PRs, 3721 Discussion records and 6319 base local notes; scoped search and live #4202 plus relevant predecessor heads were rechecked. Search does not cover unpublished work or all historical code diffs and is not a novelty certificate.

Credit Jose Manuel's original raw/normalized construction, Vlado's circuit and phase-cell lineage, Jeremy Kothe's raw identities, Mason Hale's intervals, Chafik Boukhalfa's phases, Cinna Davis's later caller and ToikY/#4220's scalar audit. Prepared for Brian (`JoyboyBrian`) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Agent cross-review is part of the author process, not independent human/formal acceptance. Hosted CI is not yet claimed.
